text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I-I look forward to working with you, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! I had to make a quick trip 
out to Funabashi...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, n-no. When I said Funabashi, I just 
meant I was exploring the city on an 
online map, but—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I just got caught up in having 
fun touring the city... and stayed up 
late――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Furioso wasn't able to get much 
rest—
